meaning: Before plotting, the model trace is slid in time to best correlate with the measured ABP, capped at half a beat and rejected below r=0.3. Visual agreement in the decks therefore reflects phase-aligned traces, not raw model timing.

could_move.what: Apparent phase agreement between model and data in the overlay; a shift up to half a beat is absorbed silently
Model-vs-model and model-vs-patient comparisons, where each trace may be shifted differently, changing perceived lead/lag
Channels with weak or missing ABP return (0.0, NaN) and stay unshifted, so some panels are aligned and others are not
Figures depend on min_r=0.3 and max_samples=4000; changing either can change the chosen shift

expectation: Direction unknown. Magnitude bounded by half a cardiac cycle per trace, and zero when ABP is unusable or correlation stays under 0.3. Whether fitted parameters or residuals are affected cannot be told from this context.

check.why: Replots one deck without re-fitting, so the applied shift and any unshifted (NaN) channels can be inspected directly.
